posts.title: Fun With Ikea's Dirigera
posts.description: I’ve always wanted to know what’s running on IKEA’s DIRIGERA, it’s a great little device, it runs most of my apartment’s smart devices… but how does it work? First up we gotta say fanks to IKEA for actually providing - this is great, it shows all changes the IKEA team made to open source software , what I wanna see is the juicy bits, userland daemons, what’s driving the Matter and ZigBee radios/de

posts.title: Bypassing MEO's XGS-PON ONT with the WAS-110
posts.description: If there’s one thing I like, it’s having control over the edge network, thanks to the 8311 Project bypassing your ISPs ONT with the WAS-110 is pretty easy, however, not all OLTs (PTIN in my case) support changing out the provided ONT with a custom device such as the WAS-110.
